about: Attorney Allen C. Frankel is the founder and senior attorney at the Law Office of Allen Frankel in New York, New York. Serving a diverse range of clients throughout the greater New York City metro regions of New York and New Jersey, Mr. Frankel is a general practitioner who provides exceptional counsel and support to those who have legal needs both in business and personal matters. His work involves Federal and State practice in any of the following:

In addition, Mr. Frankel routinely serves as outside counsel to corporations, assisting with their needs involving contract negotiations, stock purchase agreements, operating agreements, shareholder and partnerships agreements, and a variety of transactional matters.
Mr. Frankel also has extensive experience with real estate law, environmental law and licensing agreements.

No matter the issues his clients are facing, Mr. Frankel strives to deliver the highest level of representation to help them protect their rights and significantly increase the odds of achieving the favorable outcomes they expect and deserve as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. Recognized for his success, he has earned top ratings and endorsements from his peers along with many positive reviews and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 1989 graduate of Rutgers University, Mr. Frankel attended Cardozo School of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor, cum laude, in 1993. While in law school, he has heavily involved with the Cardozo Law Review, and he was a participant of the Alternative Dispute Resolution/Mediation Clinic and the Intensive Trial Advocacy Program.

Mr. Frankel is admitted to practice before federal and state courts in New York and New Jersey, as well as before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit. He is also an active member of the New York State Bar Association, among his other professional affiliations.
honors: Recognized as one of New York’s top attorneys
